# Omar Alawa

> AI & Data Product Engineer based in Cairo, Egypt. Builds end-to-end data and AI products: ERP/POS/HIS integrations, data warehouses, Power BI, and LLM-based automation (n8n, AI agents, RAG).

## About

Omar Alawa works across data engineering, business intelligence and applied AI. His work has reached 50+ stakeholders across retail, manufacturing and healthcare, including an RFM reactivation model that contributed approximately EGP 1.5M in incremental revenue and reporting automation that cut manual reporting time by up to 95%.
